```python
import re

def text_match_one(text):
    return bool(re.search(r'ab+', text))
```

I kept the `re.search` version rather than the anchored `^ab+$` from the note. The task asks whether the string contains an "a" followed by one or more "b"s, so `"xabbbx"` should match. Anchoring with `^` and `$` would reject it. `re.match('ab*')` is also wrong because `*` allows zero b's, so `"ac"` would return True.
